title: Newborn Mice Developmental Milestones
author: Sarah van Veen
materials: On P1, weigh each pup and genotype it.
Determine and record sex of each pup.
Sensorimotor domain: Tactile reflex, motor coordination
Sensorimotor domain: Reflex — labyrinthine, strength, coordination

steps.title: Mark individual pups
steps.instruction: Apply a non‑toxic marker or a small identification tattoo to each newborn mouse to reliably distinguish individual pups.

steps.title: Assess reflex and coordination
steps.instruction: Test each pup for sensorimotor reflexes in the labyrinthine and body‑righting domains, evaluating strength and overall coordination.

steps.title: Assess locomotion
steps.instruction: Test each pup for sensorimotor locomotion, focusing on extinguishment of pivoting and limb coordination.

substeps.instruction: Observe and record pivoting behavior until it ceases.

steps.title: Analyze milestone data
steps.instruction: For each milestone test, calculate the mean postnatal day of acquisition per litter (WT and KO separately), treat litter means as independent observations, perform a nested two‑tailed t test, and apply Bonferroni correction across the nine milestone tests (multiply each raw p‑value by 9; significance threshold α = 0.0056).
